Salomo mpanimfoɔ
1Na Ɔhene Salomo di Israel nyinaa so hene. 2#1 Ah 2.35 Na yeinom ne ne mmapɔmma: Sadok ba Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria; 3Sisa mma Elihoref na Ahia ne atwerɛfoɔ; Ahilud ba Yosafat ne ɔsɛnkaefoɔ; 4#1 Ah 2.35; 2 Sa 23.20 Yoiada ba Benaia di asraadɔm no so, na Sadok ne Abiatar di asɔfoɔ; 5Natan ba Asaria di toɔ sohwɛfoɔ so, na Natan ba Sabud yɛ ɔsɔfoɔ ne ɔhene adamfo; 6#1 Ah 5.14 na Ahisar di ahemfie so, na Abda ba Adoniram di wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ adwuma so.
7Na Salomo wɔ toɔ sohwɛfoɔ dummienu Israel nyinaa so a wɔhwɛ ɔhene ne ne fie aduane soɔ; afirinhyia mu bosome baako wɔn mu biara ma aduane. 8Wɔn din nie: Hur ba wɔ Efraim bepɔ so; 9Deker ba wɔ Makas ne Saalbim ne Bat-semes ne Elon-bet-anan; 10Hesed ba wɔ Arubot, (ne deɛ ne Soko ne Hefer asase nyinaa); 11#1 Sa 16.8 Abinadab ba wɔ Nafat-dor nyinaa. (Ɔwaree Salomo babaa Tafat). 12Ahilud ba Baana wɔ Taanak ne Megido ne Bet-sean a ɛwɔ Saretan nkyɛn mu nyinaa Yesreel ase, de firi Bet-sean kɔduru Abel-mehola, de kɔ Yokmeam akyi; 13#Num 32.41 Geber ba wɔ Ramot-gilead, (ne deɛ ne Manase ba Yair atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Gilead no, ne deɛ nso ne Argob asase a ɛwɔ Basan, nkuro akɛseɛ aduosia a ɛho wɔ afasuo ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adaban); 14Ido ba Abinadab wɔ Mahanaim; 15Ahimaas wɔ Naftali; (ɔno nso faa Salomo ba Basmat wareɛ); 16Husai ba Baana wɔ Aser ne Alot; 17Parua ba Yehosafat wɔ Isakar; 18Ela ba Simei wɔ Benyamin; 19Uri ba Geber wɔ Gilead asase so, Amorifoɔ hene Sihon ne Basanhene Og asase so, na toɔ sohwɛfoɔ baako na ɔwɔ Yuda asase no soɔ.
20 # 1 Ah 3.8; Gye 13.16; 22.17 Yuda ne Israel dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea dodoɔ, wɔdidi na wɔnom, na wɔn ani gye.
Salomo tumi
21Na Salomo dii aman yi so firi Asubɔntene Eufrate ano kɔsi Filistifoɔ asase so ne Misraim hyeɛ so. Wɔde apeatoɔ ba na wɔsomm Salomo ne nkwa nna nyinaa. 22Na Salomo da koro aduane yɛ esiam pa susukoraa aduasa ne ayuosiam susukoraa aduosia; 23anantwie a wɔadorɔ du ne adidibea anantwie aduonu ne nnwan ɔha, ɛsono aforoteɛ, nnowa, awansane ne nnomaa a wɔadorɔ. 24Na ɔdi asubɔnten no atɔeɛ ahemfo a wɔwɔ asubɔnten no fa ha nyinaa so tumi firi Tifsa bɛduru Gasa, na ɔnyaa asomdwoeɛ n’ahyeɛ nyinaa so hyiae. 25#Lew 25.18; 2 Ah 18.31 Na Yuda ne Israel tenaa ase dwoodwoo wɔn bobe ne wɔn borɔdɔma ase mmaako mmaako firi Dan kɔsi Beer-seba, Salomo nna nyinaa. 26Na Salomo wɔ apɔnkɔdan mpem aduanan ma ne nteaseɛnam, ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem dummienu. 27Na ɛtoɔ sohwɛfoɔ no hwɛɛ aduane so maa Ɔhene Salomo ne wɔn a wɔbaa Ɔhene Salomo pono ho nyinaa, obiara wɔ ne bosome mu; wɔmma hwee nka. 28Na atokoɔ ne ɛserɛ a wɔde ma apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔ ahoɔharefoɔ nso, wɔde baa faako a wɔwɔ hɔ, wɔn nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔahyehyɛ ama wɔn no.
Salomo nyansa
29 # 1 Ah 3.12 Na Onyankopɔn maa Salomo nyansa ne nhunumu bebree pa ne adwene a emu trɛ sɛ mpoano anwea. 30Na Salomo nyansa dɔɔso sene apueeɛ mma nyinaa nyansa ne Misraim nyansa nyinaa. 31Na ɔnim nyansa sene nnipa nyinaa, ɔsene Esrahini Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol ne Darda a wɔyɛ Mahel mma no, na ne din hyetae wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu. 32#Skf 12.9 Na ɔbubuu mmɛ mpensa, na ne nnwom yɛ apem ne nnum. 33Na ɔkasaa nnua ho firi tweneduro a ɛwɔ Lebanon so kɔsii adwera a ɛfifiri ɔfasuo mu so, na ɔkaa mmoa ne nnomaa ne wɔn a wɔwea ne mpataa ho asɛm. 34#1 Ah 10.1, 6 Na amanaman nyinaa mu bi baa sɛ wɔrebɛtie Salomo nyansa, wɔfirii asase so ahemfo a wɔtee ne nyansa no nyinaa nkyɛn bae.

Na Ɔhene Salomo di Israel nyinaa so hene. Na yeinom ne ne mmapɔmma: Sadok ba Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria; Sisa mma Elihoref na Ahia ne atwerɛfoɔ; Ahilud ba Yosafat ne ɔsɛnkaefoɔ; Yoiada ba Benaia di asraadɔm no so, na Sadok ne Abiatar di asɔfoɔ; Natan ba Asaria di toɔ sohwɛfoɔ so, na Natan ba Sabud yɛ ɔsɔfoɔ ne ɔhene adamfo; na Ahisar di ahemfie so, na Abda ba Adoniram di wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ adwuma so.
Na Salomo wɔ toɔ sohwɛfoɔ dummienu Israel nyinaa so a wɔhwɛ ɔhene ne ne fie aduane soɔ; afirinhyia mu bosome baako wɔn mu biara ma aduane. Wɔn din nie: Hur ba wɔ Efraim bepɔ so; Deker ba wɔ Makas ne Saalbim ne Bat-semes ne Elon-bet-anan; Hesed ba wɔ Arubot, (ne deɛ ne Soko ne Hefer asase nyinaa); Abinadab ba wɔ Nafat-dor nyinaa. (Ɔwaree Salomo babaa Tafat). Ahilud ba Baana wɔ Taanak ne Megido ne Bet-sean a ɛwɔ Saretan nkyɛn mu nyinaa Yesreel ase, de firi Bet-sean kɔduru Abel-mehola, de kɔ Yokmeam akyi; Geber ba wɔ Ramot-gilead, (ne deɛ ne Manase ba Yair atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Gilead no, ne deɛ nso ne Argob asase a ɛwɔ Basan, nkuro akɛseɛ aduosia a ɛho wɔ afasuo ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ adaban); Ido ba Abinadab wɔ Mahanaim; Ahimaas wɔ Naftali; (ɔno nso faa Salomo ba Basmat wareɛ); Husai ba Baana wɔ Aser ne Alot; Parua ba Yehosafat wɔ Isakar; Ela ba Simei wɔ Benyamin; Uri ba Geber wɔ Gilead asase so, Amorifoɔ hene Sihon ne Basanhene Og asase so, na toɔ sohwɛfoɔ baako na ɔwɔ Yuda asase no soɔ.
Yuda ne Israel dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea dodoɔ, wɔdidi na wɔnom, na wɔn ani gye.

Na Salomo dii aman yi so firi Asubɔntene Eufrate ano kɔsi Filistifoɔ asase so ne Misraim hyeɛ so. Wɔde apeatoɔ ba na wɔsomm Salomo ne nkwa nna nyinaa. Na Salomo da koro aduane yɛ esiam pa susukoraa aduasa ne ayuosiam susukoraa aduosia; anantwie a wɔadorɔ du ne adidibea anantwie aduonu ne nnwan ɔha, ɛsono aforoteɛ, nnowa, awansane ne nnomaa a wɔadorɔ. Na ɔdi asubɔnten no atɔeɛ ahemfo a wɔwɔ asubɔnten no fa ha nyinaa so tumi firi Tifsa bɛduru Gasa, na ɔnyaa asomdwoeɛ n’ahyeɛ nyinaa so hyiae. Na Yuda ne Israel tenaa ase dwoodwoo wɔn bobe ne wɔn borɔdɔma ase mmaako mmaako firi Dan kɔsi Beer-seba, Salomo nna nyinaa. Na Salomo wɔ apɔnkɔdan mpem aduanan ma ne nteaseɛnam, ne apɔnkɔsotefoɔ mpem dummienu. Na ɛtoɔ sohwɛfoɔ no hwɛɛ aduane so maa Ɔhene Salomo ne wɔn a wɔbaa Ɔhene Salomo pono ho nyinaa, obiara wɔ ne bosome mu; wɔmma hwee nka. Na atokoɔ ne ɛserɛ a wɔde ma apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔ ahoɔharefoɔ nso, wɔde baa faako a wɔwɔ hɔ, wɔn nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔahyehyɛ ama wɔn no.

Na Onyankopɔn maa Salomo nyansa ne nhunumu bebree pa ne adwene a emu trɛ sɛ mpoano anwea. Na Salomo nyansa dɔɔso sene apueeɛ mma nyinaa nyansa ne Misraim nyansa nyinaa. Na ɔnim nyansa sene nnipa nyinaa, ɔsene Esrahini Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol ne Darda a wɔyɛ Mahel mma no, na ne din hyetae wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu. Na ɔbubuu mmɛ mpensa, na ne nnwom yɛ apem ne nnum. Na ɔkasaa nnua ho firi tweneduro a ɛwɔ Lebanon so kɔsii adwera a ɛfifiri ɔfasuo mu so, na ɔkaa mmoa ne nnomaa ne wɔn a wɔwea ne mpataa ho asɛm. Na amanaman nyinaa mu bi baa sɛ wɔrebɛtie Salomo nyansa, wɔfirii asase so ahemfo a wɔtee ne nyansa no nyinaa nkyɛn bae.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
